scope: npm development and build-time dependencies only
releaseDecision: allowed only while npm audit --omit=dev reports zero findings
rationale: The findings are in the React Native, Jest, ESLint, and CLI build/test graph, not the packaged production dependency graph.
npm audit's suggested remediations include incompatible React Native/Jest changes or a CLI version outside the pinned React Native 0.86.2 template stack.
Unsafe automatic npm audit fix is forbidden. The full graph remains visible in CI and this exception expires for re-review.
requiredControls: the full npm audit report must be uploaded by CI
release artifacts must pass the APK/AAB content, signature, ABI, alignment, and dependency-closure gates
